spec.grading_notes: The question asks for reasons, so each part needs both the effect (rate decreases) and the reason. Accept equivalent wording, e.g. 'less light energy for photosynthesis' or 'less CO2 enters the leaf'.
parser_warnings: The rubric does not say whether a part earns any credit if it gives the effect (decrease) without the reason. Each criterion is treated as needing both. Please check.
